lead: The sentence has both, either, neither or not only, or a list joined by and or or. Find the partner word or the other items, and make the blank match them.
句子裡有 both、either、neither、not only，或用 and、or 連接的列舉。找出成對的另一半或其他項目，讓空格跟它們一致。
steps: If you see both, either, neither or not only, find the partner: and, or, nor, but also.
看到 both、either、neither 或 not only，就找它的另一半：and、or、nor、but also。
In a list, name the form of the other items: noun, adjective, base verb, -ing, or to + verb.
遇到列舉，先判斷其他項目的形式：名詞、形容詞、原形動詞、-ing，或 to + 動詞。
Choose the option with the same form, and the same pattern after the partner word.
選形式相同的選項，而且成對連接詞兩邊的結構也要一致。

head: Paired conjunctions
成對連接詞
body: both A and B, either A or B, neither A nor B, not only A but also B, whether A or B. The first word fixes the second. They cannot be mixed.
both A and B、either A or B、neither A nor B、not only A but also B、whether A or B。前一個字決定後一個字，不能混用。
ex: The new model is both lighter and cheaper.
新型號更輕，也更便宜。
You can pay either by credit card or by bank transfer.
你可以用信用卡或銀行轉帳付款。
The software is not only fast but also easy to use.
這款軟體不但快，而且好用。

head: Same form on both sides
兩邊的形式要一致
body: After and, or, but, each item has the same form as the one before: noun with noun, adjective with adjective, base verb with base verb, -ing with -ing.
用 and、or、but 連接時，每一項和前一項的形式要相同：名詞配名詞、形容詞配形容詞、原形動詞配原形動詞、-ing 配 -ing。
ex: The job requires creativity, patience, and attention to detail.
這份工作需要創意、耐心和對細節的關注。
Our goal is to design, test, and install the system by June.
我們的目標是在六月前設計、測試並安裝這套系統。
The course is practical, affordable, and easy to follow.
這門課很實用、價格合理，也容易跟上。

head: Neither … nor and either … or: the verb
neither … nor 和 either … or 的動詞
body: With neither … nor and either … or, the verb agrees with the noun closer to it.
用 neither … nor 和 either … or 時，動詞和離它比較近的那個名詞一致。
ex: Neither the director nor her assistants were available.
主任和她的助理們都沒空。
Either the manager or the supervisors are expected to attend.
經理或主管們，要有一方出席。

head: Repeat the same structure
重複相同的結構
body: When each item begins with the same pattern, repeat it each time: how to … and how to …, what … and what ….
每一項開頭的句型相同時，每一項都要重複：how to … and how to …、what … and what …。
ex: The training covers how to write reports and how to give presentations.
訓練內容包括如何寫報告和如何做簡報。
The report explains what went wrong and what should change next quarter.
報告說明了哪裡出了問題，以及下一季應該改變什麼。

head: rather than and instead of
rather than 和 instead of
body: rather than joins two items of the same form. instead of is a preposition, so a noun or -ing follows it.
rather than 連接兩個形式相同的項目。instead of 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 -ing。
ex: Many customers choose to pay online rather than visit a branch.
許多顧客選擇線上付款，而不是去分行辦理。
The team met by video call instead of traveling to Osaka.
團隊用視訊會議開會，而不是飛到大阪。

head: Not only at the start of a sentence
Not only 放在句首
body: When not only opens the sentence, the first clause inverts: auxiliary before subject. The second clause stays normal: but it also ….
not only 放在句首時，前半句要倒裝：助動詞放到主詞前面。後半句維持正常語序：but it also …。
ex: Not only does the app save time, but it also reduces costs.
這個 App 不但省時間，還能降低成本。

pairs.right: The course is both practical and affordable.
pairs.wrong: The course is both practical or affordable.

pairs.right: The app is reliable, affordable, and easy to use.
pairs.wrong: The app is reliable, affordable, and ease of use.
why: The first two items are adjectives, so the third must be an adjective phrase too.
前兩項是形容詞，第三項也要是形容詞片語。

pairs.right: The manager asked us to review the file, correct the errors, and send it back.
pairs.wrong: The manager asked us to review the file, correct the errors, and sending it back.
why: The three verbs share to and stay in the base form.
三個動詞共用 to，都用原形。

pairs.right: Neither the printer nor the scanner is working.
pairs.wrong: Neither the printer or the scanner is working.

traps: Check the partner word first: both needs and, neither needs nor, either needs or, not only needs but also. The blank can sit on either half of the pair.
先檢查成對的另一半：both 配 and，neither 配 nor，either 配 or，not only 配 but also。空格可能在成對的任何一半。
Parallel does not mean the same length. quick service and a wide range of products are both noun phrases, so they match.
平行不是長度相同。quick service 和 a wide range of products 都是名詞片語，所以是平行的。
In to design, test, and install, the later verbs share to and stay in the base form. An -ing or past form there breaks the pattern.
在 to design, test, and install 中，後面的動詞共用 to，維持原形。換成 -ing 或過去式就破壞了平行。
